fullDescription: Kaboom Pro is a futuristic, cyberpunk-themed 'Command Center' admin dashboard. It features a high-contrast dark mode aesthetic using a deep navy background (#0F0F1A) with vibrant neon accents in cyan (#00D1FF), pink (#FF00E5), yellow (#FFD600), and green (#00FF94). The design utilizes editorial typography with Clash Display and Plus Jakarta Sans, incorporating glassmorphism, 3D-inspired shadows, and complex micro-interactions like rotating orbits, pulsing nodes, and animated bar charts. It is ideal for high-tech SaaS, fintech, gaming analytics, or event management platforms requiring a premium, energetic operational oversight interface.

structured.summary: A neon-infused, high-tech admin dashboard with a fixed sidebar, bento-grid metric cards, interactive holographic visualizations, and a detailed data table. The UI emphasizes real-time platform vitals through dynamic animations and bold, oversized typography.

style.description: The style is 'Cyber-Industrial' combining dark mode elegance with neon brutalism. Typography pairs 'Clash Display' for bold, expressive headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for clean, readable body text. Color palette: Background #0F0F1A, Sidebar #1A1A2E, Card surfaces #2D2D4A. Accents: Cyan #00D1FF (primary action/active), Pink #FF00E5 (alerts/secondary), Yellow #FFD600 (highlights), Green #00FF94 (success/health). Key visual treatments include 2px neon borders, glassmorphic blurs (12px), and 'hologram' glows using inset shadows and low-opacity color bursts.
style.prompt: Create a design with a background of #0F0F1A and a card surface of #2D2D4A. Use 'Clash Display' (weights 600-900) for headers and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (400-700) for UI elements. Implement a neon color system: Yellow (#FFD600), Pink (#FF00E5), Cyan (#00D1FF), and Green (#00FF94). All cards should have a 1px border of white/10 or a 2px colored neon border with matching box-shadow (0 0 10px rgba(color, 0.3)). Apply glassmorphism with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and `background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Navigation items should use 16px (1rem) sizing with active states highlighted in Cyan (#00D1FF) and a 5% white background. Use 'holographic' effects with rotating dashed orbits and pulsing core icons.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a classic admin structure with a fixed 72px width sidebar on the left and a scrollable main content area. Content is organized in a modular grid, featuring a 4-column metric row, a split 2:1 row for charts and holograms, and a full-width data table.

prompts.prompt: A 288px (w-72) fixed sidebar in #1A1A2E. Top section: Brand logo link with a tilted yellow square icon (#FFD600) and black popper icon, text 'KABOOM.' in Clash Display. Middle: Navigation list with items having 16px padding, 24px gap, and rounded-2xl corners. Active item style: text-cyan-400, border-white/10, bg-white/5. Bottom: Admin profile card with a circular avatar, yellow border, and a green online status indicator.

A flexible header with a 32px (2rem) title 'Command Center' in Clash Display followed by a yellow lightning emoji. Includes a sub-headline in white/40. Right side: A status pill (green-400/10 background, green-400 text) with a pulsing dot and 'All Nodes Nominal' text in 10px all-caps tracking-widest. Two glassmorphic action buttons (bell and search) with rounded-2xl corners.

Four columns of cards (bg #2D2D4A) with rounded-[2.5rem] (40px) corners. Each card includes: a 48px colored icon box, a percentage change indicator, all-caps metadata label, and 36px font-display value. Bottom of each card features a slim 4px progress bar in the card's accent color. Hover state: transition border color to match the accent color.

A 2-column grid (ratio 2:1). Left column: 'Platform Engagement' bar chart with rounded-3xl corners. Custom bar heights with hover tooltips and a background grid of subtle white/5 lines. Right column: 'Traffic Hologram' featuring concentric dashed circles with `orbit-anim` (10s linear rotate) and a pulsing globe icon in a cyan glow center. Includes a vertical stack of status pills below the hologram.

Full-width section titled 'Recent Event Protocols'. Table uses `border-separate` with `border-spacing-y-4` to create floating row effects. Rows have bg-white/0.02 and hover bg-white/0.04. Columns: Event Identifier (with emoji icon), Creator, Status (using colored pill tags), Capacity (with slim progress bar), and Action (more-horizontal icon button).

special_ui_components.description: A complex decorative visualization representing system traffic.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a 192px (w-48 h-48) container. Inside, place two concentric dashed borders: Outer circle (cyan-400/20) rotating clockwise 10s; Inner circle (pink-500/20) rotating counter-clockwise 15s. Center: a 128px cyan-glow circle with a pulsing Globe icon. Scatter two small glowing nodes (pink and yellow) at various orbit points with `pulse-fast` animation.

A sequence of four 8px wide bars in Green (#00FF94). Each bar should have `animation: barFlow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate`. Stagger the animation start times using 0.1s, 0.2s, and 0.4s delays. Heights should fluctuate between 20% and 100% of the 24px container.

Stacked components in the bottom-right corner. Top: A horizontal support pill (bg #2D2D4A) with a cyan icon and 'Live Support' text. Bottom: A 64px (w-16 h-16) white circular button with a black plus icon, featuring a high-intensity white shadow (0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)). Scale on hover: 1.1x.
